title: A homogeneous catalytic cycle
caption: Peroxodisulfate and iodide ions are both negative and repel, so they react slowly. Fe²⁺ catalyses the reaction: it reduces S₂O₈²⁻ and becomes Fe³⁺, which oxidises I⁻ back to I₂ and becomes Fe²⁺ again. Each step is between oppositely charged ions.
alt: A cycle between Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺: S₂O₈²⁻ converts Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, and I⁻ converts Fe³⁺ back to Fe²⁺.
description: Overall: S₂O₈²⁻ + 2I⁻ → 2SO₄²⁻ + I₂, with the iron regenerated.
